problem:
If
    $A=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -5\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $A.$

  

| ${A}^{T}=$ |  | {{field-1}} | {{field-2}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{A}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}4 & -5\end{aligned}]
$$
